release.name: NeelaOS v1.2.3
release.notes:
# NeelaOS 1.2.3

*OS, for the love of wind*

A fresh look at your files, and a smoother desktop. Install it from
**Neela Store → Updates**, or in the Terminal:

    sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade

Then log out and back in to finish.

---

## ✨ What's new

### 📁 Meet the new Files
Files is now powered by **Nemo**, a fast, familiar file manager that feels right
at home if you're coming from Windows.

- **Opens everywhere:** double-click a folder, press **Win + E**, or use the Files
  icon on your desktop and taskbar.
- **Open in Terminal:** right-click any folder to open it in NeelaOS's Terminal.
- **Thumbnails** for photos, videos and documents.
- **Opens maximized**, so the minimize, maximize and close buttons are always on screen.

Already using NeelaOS? 
Your desktop shortcut, taskbar pin and Win + E switch to the new Files automatically at your next login. Nothing to set up.

## 🛠️ Fixes and polish

- **Clean desktop icons:** desktop shortcuts no longer show a "!" warning sign.
- **Quieter Files:** removed actions that only work on other desktops, so no more
  stray warnings.
- **Better first run** for new accounts on fresh installs.

---

Thanks for using NeelaOS. 
Made with 💙 by @ettisafxrup

author.name: Ettisaf Rup
author.bio: Ettisaf Rup designed, built and owns NeelaOS. He created it so Computer Science students can start learning to code on day one, instead of spending their first weeks fighting setup.
author.bio2: He also wrote rgit, the friendly Git companion that ships with NeelaOS.

faq.a: Yes, completely: no licence, no subscription, no ads.
Download the NeelaOS-x86_64.iso file and its .sha256 checksum from the official GitHub Releases page at github.com/NeelaOS/NeelaOS/releases, or use the Download NeelaOS button on neelaos.github.io.
No. NeelaOS is Linux (a Fedora Remix built on Fedora 44 and KDE Plasma 6) designed to feel familiar to Windows users. Windows programs don't run natively.

faq.q: Can I still use Microsoft Office?
faq.a: Office in the browser works, and LibreOffice comes with an Office-style ribbon and saves to .docx, .xlsx and .pptx by default. The desktop version of Microsoft Office doesn't run.
Many Windows games run through Steam's Proton (available as a Dev pack). Games with anti-cheat systems usually don't.
Yes. Neela Setup can install NeelaOS alongside Windows, and you choose which one to start each time.

faq.q: Will it run on my laptop?
faq.a: Most 64-bit Intel or AMD laptops and desktops from the last ten years run NeelaOS well. Try it live from the USB first; nothing changes on your PC until you install.
Open Neela Store → Updates, or run sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade in the Terminal. Fedora, NeelaOS, Brave and VS Code updates arrive together, and a restore point is taken before every update.
Open Restore Points and go back to a moment before the problem, like Windows System Restore. Your personal files are kept.
No. Use Neela Store (Flatpak) or the app's .rpm version instead. Ubuntu-style commands like sudo apt install build-essential do work.
NeelaOS uses Fedora's packages, security updates and signed boot chain, so Secure Boot works out of the box, and it only installs software from official sources.
Neela means blue, the colour at the heart of the NeelaOS look, from navy and sea blue to teal.
